central_nonuniqueness_ensemble.initialization_distribution: independent torch seeds with Gaussian parameter perturbations at 1% of each selected-central parameter RMS scale
central_nonuniqueness_ensemble.purpose: measure residual optimization/start dependence under the selected dataset, architecture, and prior
central_nonuniqueness_ensemble.completion: increase starts until bT- and kT-space q16/q84 endpoints pass the preregistered bootstrap and split-half 2% stability gates

joint_full_uncertainty_ensemble.construction: one independently initialized converged fit for each independently generated experimental pseudo-data replica
joint_full_uncertainty_ensemble.experimental_sampling: dataset-correlated normalization draw plus rowwise uncorrelated Gaussian draw, using the accepted covariance decomposition recorded by the isolated runner
joint_full_uncertainty_ensemble.initialization_sampling: independent fit seed and 1% Gaussian parameter perturbation for every pseudo-data replica
joint_full_uncertainty_ensemble.completion: append batches until bT- and kT-space q16/q84 endpoints pass the preregistered bootstrap and split-half 2% stability gates
joint_full_uncertainty_ensemble.reported_interval: q16 to q84 of the converged joint procedural ensemble
joint_full_uncertainty_ensemble.interpretation: 68% full procedural interval including experimental propagation and residual randomized-start variation; not a Gaussian quadrature construction

selection_independence: dataset, architecture, and prior strength must pass central gates before any final-band width is inspected
